name: Stars of Elune
summary: In Darnassus, night elf acolytes are called to the Temple of the Moon after proving their devotion to their people. There, the Sisterhood of Elune teaches them sacred arts of their faith.

sections.title: A Rite of Devotion
sections.body: Night elf priests draw their holy power from Elune, their goddess, while humans and dwarves turn to the Light. When an acolyte serves the realm with steadfast devotion, the Sisterhood in Darnassus takes notice. The acolyte is summoned to the Temple of the Moon and judged ready for deeper communion. There, the priest learns sacred spells passed down through thousands of years of worship.

sections.title: Gifts of the Moon Goddess
sections.body: Priestess Alathea calls the initiate to receive instruction in holy mysteries of the night elf faith, including Starshards. These spells channel the radiant wrath and grace of the White Lady. The teaching marks an acolyte's passage beyond basic training, ready to venture beyond Teldrassil's protective canopy in Elune's name.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The Sisterhood of Elune formally recognizes an initiate's devotion. Priestess Alathea teaches the young priest night elf spells such as Starshards.
Priestess Alathea, a leader of the Sisterhood of Elune, completes the rite at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why is this quest restricted to night elves?
aliases: who can do stars of elune
faq.answer: The rites belong to the Sisterhood of Elune, the ancient priesthood of night elf faith. Kaldorei priests draw their distinct magic from communion with Elune, while other Alliance priesthoods study the Holy Light.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead within the priest storyline?
aliases: what comes before stars of elune
faq.answer: After 'Returning Home,' an aspiring priest who has helped across Teldrassil returns to the capital for further instruction at the Temple of the Moon.

faq.q: What kind of magic does Elune bestow on her priests?
faq.answer: Priests devoted to Elune weave moonlight, starlight, and shadow. Through rites such as Starshards, kaldorei worshippers call down celestial fire upon enemies, joining divine judgment with astral wrath.

faq.q: Where in Darnassus does this take place?
faq.answer: The rite takes place inside the Temple of the Moon, a marble sanctuary above Darnassus's southern quarter and the religious heart of the kaldorei nation.

angles.text: As a priest, this rite marks the path of kaldorei priests and brings you astral spells granted by the Moon Goddess.
As a kaldorei, your service to Elune is bound to civic and cultural life. Answering the Sisterhood's summons marks your coming of age in service to Teldrassil.
As an Alliance member, you stand among human and dwarven priests of the Holy Light, while night elf devotion to Elune brings ancient celestial magic to the Alliance.
